posts.title: The Meetings Are the Work
posts.description: You can look back at your calendar, see all those meetings, and think to yourself "I didn't do anything." That's the problem. It took me years to understand that those meetings are the work.

posts.title: Writing Code Was the Easy Part
posts.description: AI speeds up code generation, but it also shifts more work into defining requirements, resolving ambiguity, and reviewing whether the output actually solves the right problem.

posts.title: I Give Advice 75% of the Time. I’m Trying to Get to 50.
posts.description: I realized I was giving answers instead of helping a tech lead develop their own judgment—and undermining the ownership I wanted them to build.
